title: TC-TIB-022 — [Regression] Edit-save other GO types via artwork-editor popup unaffected
steps:
Preconditions: Staging portal; an artwork using a Global Option of another type (e.g. text)

  1. Open the artwork in the editor
  2. Open the "edit Global Option" popup for that layer
  3. Make a small change and Save
expectedResult: Same as editing via the Edit page — data saves identically as before through the new API-backed save path.
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, store linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com.

Observed (direct): In throwaway artwork #4572, added a Single-line Text layer, set Personalization Settings > "Use an existing global option" > selected GO 969 ("New Single-line Text option - QA edit TIB-5467", same GO edited in TC-021). Clicked the "Edit" button on the selected-GO summary card inside the layer panel — this opened an "Edit global option" popup dialog (General/Settings/Preview, same layout as the standalone Edit page) without leaving the artwork editor. Set Option Title = "QA edited via artwork popup", clicked Save inside the popup.

Toast appeared: "Saved — Global option has been updated successfully." The layer's GO summary card and the right-hand Preview panel both updated live to show the new label "QA edited via artwork popup". Navigated directly to /global-options/969/edit (fresh page load, bypassing the artwork) and confirmed Option Title field shows "QA edited via artwork popup" — change persisted server-side, not just a local UI update.

Conclusion (direct observation): Edit-save of a Global Option via the "edit GO" popup inside the artwork editor works correctly through the new API-backed save path — same as the standalone Edit page in TC-021. No regression observed.

Note: GO id 969 now has Option Title "QA edited via artwork popup" — left on staging, see final report.
